title: Figure 14: Ground/sea-to-space laser Lightcraft concept (Earth-to-orbit)
description: Simple schematic titled "Ground-to-Space (Earth-to-Orbit)" showing a laser beam rising from Earth's curved surface to a small Lightcraft, which follows a dashed ascent path labeled "Pico or Nano Satellites". Caption: "Figure 14. Ground/Sea-to-Space Concept: Appropriate rotation of a high-energy laser beam, emanating from a ground/sea-based laser, guides and propels an integral Lightcraft pico-/nano-satellite along an ETO ascent path..." It opens 'Chapter 3: Laser Lightcraft Weapon Mission Selection Study'.
